title: Dreame L50 Ultra Robotic Vacuum Cleaner and Mop $997 + Delivery ($0 C&C/ In-Store) @ The Good Guys
body:
Deal: Dreame L50 Ultra Robotic Vacuum Cleaner and Mop $997 + Delivery ($0 C&C/ In-Store) @ The Good Guys

[Bargainboss99] My $30 off 150 code does not seem to be working.
Same as a store credit voucher I have. Anyone else with this issue ?
[Dollar Dreamer] Or just use the Topcashback cashback discount, similar amount off.
[WookieMonster] Are those vouchers for in-store redemption only?
The $30 off $150 spend code can only be redeemed in-store.
[Vyviel] Why did we need to go back to stupid (profanity) disposable dustbags again after most normal vacs ditched them decades ago? Can't the base station just have a normal huge 3L plastic dust bin we can manually empty when its full?
[MrBr0] I have seen a few 3D print designs for reusable bags with a filler at one end to allow air flow
[Vyviel] Ill need to look those up it makes sense you could just 3d print something as the main container in the vac just has a simple hepa filter that allows airflow
[simontadaa] Bagged base stations is better due to no maintenance and fewer things to fail
